subject.statement: Do Kwon was acquitted of all US fraud charges in 2025.

summary: The claim that Do Kwon was acquitted of all US fraud charges in 2025 is FALSE; as of August 2025 he pleaded guilty to two fraud counts in the Southern District of New York, seven other counts were dropped, and a civil jury had already found him liable for securities fraud in April 2024.

findings.statement: Do Kwon’s full legal name is Do Kwon (Korean name 권도형), a South Korean cryptocurrency executive.
Do Kwon is the cofounder of Singapore-based Terraform Labs and a South Korean national.
Do Kwon was indicted on nine counts covering securities fraud, wire fraud, commodities fraud and money‑laundering conspiracy.

In August 2025 Do Kwon pleaded guilty to two fraud counts (conspiracy to commit commodities/securities/wire fraud and wire fraud); seven other counts were dropped, and he was not acquitted of any US fraud charge; a civil jury had already found him liable for securities fraud in April 2024.
